reviews.text: We have used Les Moore Construction on big projects, full building built and,  small projects as well. You won’t find a more honest contractor to work with in a world where most of them rip you off. Excellent quality work and great communication. I can’t say enough good things.
reviews.author: Heather P

reviews.text: Moore Roofing and Construction provides an exceptional amount of great customer care. One of the good things when dealing with Moore Roofing and Construction is the speed of completing the work, professionalism, and standing with the customer to solve any problem easily and smoothly. I personally am grateful to this company and its employees, especially the office manager, for facilitating communication and interactions with my insurance company
reviews.author: Zamel Alami

reviews.text: Extremely happy with our new roof and other repairs needed from the local hail storm. Les and his crew were also able to build a carport that matched the house prior to installing the new roof. These guys are true contractors, not just salesman knocking doors. We mostly appreciated the communication and attention to detail. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Zach Moore

reviews.text: We have used Moore Roofing and Construction for several years for roof replacements, two remodeled bathrooms, a flood damaged bedroom and a room addition in our home. The work is always done right and Les and his team do a great job every time. I have recommended them to friends and family and will continue to do so.
reviews.author: Dianna Lawson

reviews.text: I have used Moore Roofing and Construction multiple times. Great work, friendly folks and worked with my insurance company well! Most recently, I needed to locate an old invoice for insurance reasons and they went above and beyond to help me. I have recommended them to family and friends and hope this reviews reaches to people who are in need of a trustworthy company!
reviews.author: Elizabeth Buckenroth

reviews.text: Les removed a load-bearing wall for the previous owners of our home in Lewisville (invoices in hand). We noticed cracking drywall on each side of the span and hired a structural engineer who confirmed that a beam was needed, but one was not installed. The 2nd floor trusses for the front and back of our 2nd floor convene on this wall. It's now sagging an inch!  It's miraculous that our house did not fall in on us. If that isn't enough, no permits were pulled, and when we brought this to him to rectify, he refused to work with us.  Pics are from after removing drywall from the area in order to get a proper beam installed.
reviews.author: Nathan Chaney

reviews.text: We have used Moore roofing on three different occasions over 23 years. 2 different homes. Unfortunately due to our weather we needed a full roof replacement. The service and professionalism has been perfect each time. They are fast, fair, and work with your insurance to make your life easier. We wouldn’t consider anyone else. Beware of those roofers knocking on your door after a storm.
reviews.author: Tom Davison

reviews.text: My experience w Moore Roofing/Construction was awesome.  Les Moore reached out w progress reports on a timely manner for the patio cover/post stabilization & roof replacement! Great Company!
reviews.author: Patty Barron

data.summary: Reviews appear mostly authentic with strong evidence of long-term customer satisfaction and repeat business. The single negative review raises serious but isolated concerns about past structural work. The positive reviews show varied writing styles, specific project details, and evidence of insurance coordination. The 8-month clustering of positive reviews is slightly suspicious but could be explained by seasonal work or marketing efforts.
